title: Find the Missing Clue
story: An operator left a clue somewhere in the filesystem. Find it.

files./home/player/notes.txt:
Reminder: the clue is not in the usual places.
Try searching your whole home directory for a file named clue.
files./home/player/documents/readme.txt:
This folder holds public documents.
Nothing secret here, but every investigation starts by looking around.
files./home/player/secrets/clue.txt:
CLUE: the operator's codeword is BLUE-LANTERN.
(A fictional, harmless message. Mission complete material.)

objectives.success: Moved. Your prompt shows the new room.
hints: cd changes directory. It needs a folder name.
ls shows a folder called documents.

objectives.success: .. means the room above. You are home.
hints: You are inside documents. .. always means one level up.
find searches by name so you don't have to browse.
It takes a starting room and a -name filter.
Print the file find pointed to.
